<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/plugins/update-check"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Looks up the newest Termix release on this instance's channel and lists the installed plugins that would not load on it, so an admin can update them first. reason api means the plugin was made for plugin API 1, reason termix means its engine.termix range leaves that version out (needs says which range it asks for). version is null when no newer release is known.
